name: Pennsylvania

items.label: Pennsylvania income tax
items.note: A flat 3.07% of wages with no standard deduction.

items.label: Philadelphia wage tax
items.note: Residents pay 3.74% to 30 June 2026 and 3.735% from 1 July, so 3.7375% across the calendar year, on all compensation (Medicare wages, including 401(k) deferrals).

notModelled: Local services tax (up to $52 a year)
Local earned income taxes outside Philadelphia (usually about 1%)
provisional: Employee unemployment compensation rate (0.07%) carried over from 2026 until the 2027 figure is published
Philadelphia's wage tax rate from 1 July 2027 isn't set yet; the 2026 average is carried over from 2026 until the 2027 figure is published
